bugs.title: HTTP connector type service tasks, history records not persisted in database
bugs.description: HTTP connector service tasks in Camunda 7.16 with history-level audit were not persisting task or activity history records
technical_details: History records not appearing in ACT_HI_TASKINST and ACT_HI_ACTINST tables
Configuration: history-level set to audit
Affects HTTP connector service tasks specifically
Closed as not_planned suggesting expected behavior or documentation issue

technical_details: Regression introduced in 7.24.0
Affects timer boundary event operations
Process definition ID handling issue
Marked as duplicate of existing issue

bugs.title: Tasklist Search query not returning process variables when task is completed
bugs.description: Camunda 8.7 Tasklist search API with includeVariables only returns variables passed during task completion, not complete process variable set
technical_details: Affects completed and canceled tasks
includeVariables parameter behavior differs between active and completed tasks
Only variables explicitly passed during completion are returned
Closed as not_planned

bugs.title: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in ContainerBasedAuthenticationFilter
bugs.description: Authentication filter crashes with StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when requests lack application path suffix
technical_details: Filter assumes '/camunda' app path in all request URLs
Accessing without app-name suffix causes HTTP 500 errors
Improper string slicing without validation
Path extraction logic needs defensive checks

bugs.title: Data Migrator should filter out invalid or hidden files
bugs.description: Data Migrator attempted deploying macOS hidden files like .DS_Store causing deployment failures
technical_details: Auto deployment includes system hidden files
macOS .DS_Store files cause deployment errors
Need file type filtering for deployment
Affects C8 auto deployment process

bugs.title: Data Migrator error is cryptic when C8 datasource is not configured
bugs.description: Missing C8 datasource configuration produces unhelpful NoSuchBeanDefinitionException
technical_details: Poor error messaging for configuration issues
NoSuchBeanDefinitionException not user-friendly
Need explicit datasource configuration validation
User experience issue in migration tooling

bugs.title: Data Migrator Runtime can't complete migrated PI with parallel gateway
bugs.description: Process instances with parallel gateways couldn't complete after migration
technical_details: Parallel gateway state not properly migrated
Process instances hang after migration
Resolved by documenting to skip such instances
Indicates migration limitations with complex flow patterns

bugs.title: Data Migrator Runtime fails when migrating process without local variables
bugs.description: Migration threw 'No variables provided' error when processes lacked local variables
technical_details: Variable handling assumes non-empty variable sets
Need to handle empty variable collections gracefully
Fixed to support processes without local variables
Edge case in data migration logic

bugs.title: OR query generates 'LIKE null' instead of filled expression
bugs.description: candidateGroupLike in OR queries generated 'LIKE NULL' instead of proper expressions
technical_details: MyBatis parameter mapping issue
OR queries with LIKE operators fail
Generates invalid SQL: 'I.GROUP_ID_ LIKE null'
Query builder parameter binding bug

bugs.title: Event Subprocess History removal_time Issue
bugs.description: Event subprocess historic activity instances don't receive removal_time values
technical_details: Prevents automatic history cleanup
Affects processes with recurring timer events
removal_time field not propagated to event subprocesses
History cleanup strategy incomplete

bugs.title: Data Migrator History doesn't save createTime when data is skipped
bugs.description: Skipped entities didn't persist creation dates breaking pagination continuation logic
technical_details: createTime field not saved for skipped records
Breaks pagination during interrupted migrations
Migration restart logic relies on timestamps
Data consistency issue in migration tracking

bugs.title: ExternalTaskClient TCP session termination not detected
bugs.description: External task client fails to detect TCP session termination during long polling and cannot restart after server recovery
technical_details: Long polling requests don't detect server disconnection
Client cannot receive TCP session termination frame
No automatic reconnection after server recovery
Network resilience issue in external task pattern

bugs.title: Spring Boot 3.2.x multi-module project deployment fails
bugs.description: Camunda Spring Boot starter fails to boot with Spring Boot 3.2.x in multi-module projects
technical_details: Spring Boot 3.2 changed from jar:file to jar:nested URI schemes
IOException while scanning nested JAR archives
Nested JAR scanning incompatibility
Framework version compatibility issue

bugs.title: Optimize Client collection import failure with encoded slashes
bugs.description: Importing reports into collections via Optimize REST API fails due to encoded trailing slashes in collection IDs
technical_details: Collection IDs contain %2F suffix
API lookup fails with 'Collection does not exist'
URL encoding handling issue
REST API parameter processing bug

bugs.title: Historic process instance queries with incidents produce incorrect results
bugs.description: Queries using withIncidents combined with OR queries produce incorrect results due to improper JOIN types
technical_details: Incorrect JOIN type selection in query builder
Should use INNER JOIN for AND conditions
Should use OUTER JOIN for OR conditions
Query optimization and correctness issue

key_insights.insight: BPMN execution state management is particularly challenging with complex flow patterns like parallel gateways and event subprocesses. Migration and persistence of execution state requires careful handling of token positions, gateway convergence conditions, and event subscription states.
action_items: Design execution state model that explicitly captures token positions and gateway states
Implement robust serialization/deserialization of process instance state
Consider event subscription lifecycle management separate from main execution state
Plan for process instance migration scenarios from early architecture stage

key_insights.insight: History and audit data management requires sophisticated cleanup strategies that understand process instance boundaries and call activity relationships. Simple time-based cleanup can create orphan records and compliance issues.
action_items: Design cleanup strategy that respects process instance hierarchies
Implement removal_time propagation through all related entities
Ensure cleanup doesn't break audit trail completeness
Consider compliance requirements in cleanup design

key_insights.insight: Query performance is heavily influenced by database-specific pagination and JOIN strategies. Modern databases support more efficient pagination syntax, and JOIN type selection (INNER vs OUTER) significantly impacts both performance and correctness.
action_items: Use database-agnostic query abstraction that can optimize for specific backends
Implement proper JOIN type selection based on query semantics (AND vs OR)
Design query builder with correct parameter binding for all edge cases
Consider query performance in initial data model design

key_insights.insight: External task pattern requires robust network resilience, connection management, and polling strategies. Long polling creates challenges with connection loss detection and recovery.
action_items: Implement heartbeat mechanism for long-lived connections
Design automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
Separate fetch-and-lock from task execution for better concurrency
Consider at-least-once vs at-most-once execution semantics

key_insights.insight: Framework integration (Spring Boot, Quarkus, WildFly) requires continuous compatibility maintenance as frameworks evolve. Breaking changes in framework internals (like Spring Boot's JAR scanning) can break integrations.
action_items: Design plugin architecture with clear framework abstraction boundaries
Use framework APIs that are marked as stable/public
Implement comprehensive integration tests for supported frameworks
Monitor framework roadmaps for breaking changes

key_insights.insight: Variable handling must gracefully handle edge cases like empty variable sets, variable scope boundaries (task-local vs process-level), and variable lifecycle through task completion and process migration.
action_items: Design variable model with clear scope semantics
Handle empty variable collections without errors
Define variable persistence strategy across task lifecycle
Consider variable serialization format for long-term storage

key_insights.insight: Data migration between platform versions requires instance tracking, skip reason management, pagination support for large datasets, and ability to resume interrupted migrations. Migration validation must account for model differences.
action_items: Build migration tooling alongside core engine from start
Track migration state per entity with detailed skip reasons
Implement pagination for large dataset migrations
Provide clear error messages for configuration issues
Document migration limitations upfront

key_insights.insight: Modern workflow engines need deep integration with observability stacks (Micrometer, Actuator, metrics). Exposing engine internals through standard monitoring interfaces is crucial for production operations.
action_items: Design metrics collection from the beginning
Integrate with standard observability frameworks (Micrometer/OpenTelemetry)
Expose meaningful engine metrics (execution counts, durations, queue depths)
Enable metric aggregation and grouping for analysis

common_patterns.observation: Complex BPMN constructs (parallel gateways, event subprocesses, boundary events) have state management edge cases that surface during migration, restart, or cleanup
Query performance and syntax vary significantly across database backends, requiring dialect-specific optimizations
examples: SQL error code handling for CockroachDB

common_patterns.observation: Code often assumes non-empty collections leading to errors when variables, tasks, or other entities are absent
Framework upgrades introduce breaking changes in internal APIs (JAR scanning, component loading) that break integrations
Long-lived connections and polling patterns struggle with connection loss detection and graceful recovery
Missing or incorrect configuration produces cryptic errors rather than clear guidance

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design execution state model that explicitly captures all aspects of process instance state: token positions, gateway synchronization state, event subscriptions, and timer states. Ensure this state can be serialized, migrated, and restored.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Complex flow patterns like parallel gateways and event subprocesses have state that's difficult to reconstruct if not explicitly modeled. Migration and persistence failures stem from implicit state assumptions.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Build query abstraction that can generate database-specific optimizations (pagination syntax, JOIN strategies) while maintaining correctness across all supported databases.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Query performance varies 40x across databases without optimization. Database dialect support is critical for production performance.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Integrate with standard observability frameworks (Micrometer/OpenTelemetry) from initial implementation. Expose meaningful engine metrics for execution counts, durations, queue depths, and error rates.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Production operations require deep visibility into engine behavior. Retrofit observability is harder than designing it in from the start.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement heartbeat, connection pooling, automatic reconnection with exponential backoff, and circuit breaker patterns for all network interactions including external task patterns.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Long-lived connections and polling patterns fail in production without robust connection management and recovery.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design history data model with explicit cleanup semantics. Implement removal_time propagation through entity hierarchies. Ensure cleanup respects process instance boundaries and call activity relationships.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: History cleanup is complex and affects compliance. Simple time-based cleanup creates orphan records and incomplete audit trails.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Build migration tools alongside core engine. Support instance tracking, skip reason management, pagination for large datasets, and resumable migrations. Document limitations upfront.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Version migration is inevitable and complex. Building migration support after the fact is much harder than planning for it.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Define clear variable scope semantics (task-local vs process-level vs global). Handle empty variable sets gracefully. Design variable persistence through complete task and process lifecycle.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Variable handling edge cases cause runtime failures. Clear scope semantics prevent confusion and bugs.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Define clear abstraction boundaries for framework integrations. Use only stable/public framework APIs. Implement comprehensive integration tests with matrix of supported framework versions.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Framework evolution breaks integrations that depend on internal APIs. Clear boundaries and extensive testing are essential.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Validate all configuration at startup with clear error messages. Provide actionable guidance for common configuration mistakes. Fail fast with helpful diagnostics.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Cryptic errors frustrate users and increase support burden. Clear configuration validation improves user experience.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Never assume collections are non-empty. Handle null and empty cases gracefully throughout the codebase as standard practice.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Empty collection assumptions cause runtime failures in edge cases. Defensive programming prevents these common bugs.
